summary: Final route-meeting readout for Valquessia Pharmaceuticals SpA. The aminoquinoline side-chain programme supports the salt-forming candidate for scale-up because final isolation proved reproducible, while the delivery data remain compound-specific.

slides.title: VP10: side-chain choice and isolation
slides.subtitle:
Valquessia Pharmaceuticals SpA | VD-16-033 | 30 Aug 2016
Dr R. Calderwood | Route meeting

slides.title: Decision: progress the salt-forming side chain
bullets: {{PRJ0019:n_compounds}} aminoquinoline analogues comprise the delivered set.
Valquessia selected the salt-forming side chain for scale-up.
Reproducible final isolation was the deciding chemistry observation.
Selection is a route decision, not a claim of improved mitotic-kinase activity.

slides.title: Delivered analogue set: isolation and release
Side-chain variation on the aminoquinoline core
Side-chain comparison: useful material versus a good reaction
bullets: A solubilising side chain is useful only if the product can be recovered consistently.
Reaction completion alone does not settle isolation feasibility.
The delivered set defines the structures actually available.
bullets_right: The salt-forming candidate gave a reproducible final isolation.
That observation supports a practical scale-up starting point.
Other side chains remain comparators; their structures are not scale-up commitments.

slides.title: Purity context for the delivered set
Why reproducibility changes the route gate
bullets: A repeatable isolation reduces dependence on a difficult final clean-up.
Carry the selected side-chain identity through the compound card and salt preparation.
Keep isolation behaviour separate from assumptions about solution properties.
A larger preparation must still demonstrate that the small-scale isolation transfers.

slides.title: Scale-up route scout
bullets: Hassan Darwish to retain the selected sequence as the starting procedure.
Track solvent charge, addition order and isolation hold in the route scout.
Retain the final mother liquor until material accounting is closed.
bullets_right: Clara Fenwick to link release material to the compound card.
Compare the new preparation against the delivered reference.
Ruth Calderwood to assess the route gate after isolation, not merely after conversion.

slides.title: Meeting close: selection agreed
bullets: Valquessia Pharmaceuticals SpA has selected the salt-forming side chain.
Prepare the scale-up route scout around reproducible isolation.
Keep alternative side chains available as chemistry comparators.
Confirm the requested scale and delivery allocation before the next preparation.
slides.notes: Programme began 11 Apr 2016; final readout 30 Aug 2016. This deck closes the analogue-preparation programme, not the future scale-up work.
